description: Grants canvasd's own pages, served through the canvas:// scheme into the main and settings windows, access to set_pinned, get_pinned, open_settings, daemon_status, take_pending_card, listening for the canvas-event and canvas-stream events the daemon bridge emits, and starting a window drag from a title bar. Tauri treats a custom scheme as local, so local is true; nothing else core:default or any other capability would imply is granted.
